divergences.toil: Split's workspace is --ws <id> (the MCP field is still workspace), or the connection's workspace setting (TOIL_SPLITIO_WORKSPACE). A command without one fails with INVALID_INPUT saying --workspace is toil's file-workspace flag and to pass --ws
divergences.why: --workspace is toil's global flag for the folder commands may read files in, and the CLI parser takes it wherever it appears, so a leaf flag of the same name could never be reached. A call that passes --workspace <id>, as the contract records, sets the file workspace to the ID and then gets the plain error telling it to use --ws.

divergences.old: Every write asking "Submit Change Request ...?" on the terminal unless --yes is given; declining ends with "Aborted by user." and exit code 0
divergences.toil: No prompt and no --yes. A write needs writes: true on the connection and --allow-write on the call, and fails with WRITE_DISABLED naming the missing one
divergences.why: toil's write gate replaces per-command confirmation everywhere. It also settles #79 item 13: the prompt blocked --input-file - and unattended runs.

divergences.old: flags get, set-rule and set-default reading /internal/api/v2/splits/ws/{ws}/name/{flag} and .../name/{flag}/environment/{env} (#79 item 1)
divergences.toil: GET /splits/ws/{ws}/{flag} and /splits/ws/{ws}/{flag}/environments/{env}, as Split documents them: https://docs.split.io/reference/get-feature-flag and https://docs.split.io/reference/get-feature-flag-definition-in-environment
divergences.why: The recorded integration had never been run against a live account, so the maintainer had it rebuilt from the vendor docs (#29). The recorded paths have a name/ segment and a singular environment that the reference has not.

divergences.old: Every write POSTing to /internal/api/v2/changeRequests/ws/{ws} with the environment inside the body as split.environment.id; flags archive taking no --environment (#79 item 2)
divergences.toil: POST /changeRequests/ws/{ws}/environments/{env} (https://docs.split.io/reference/create-change-request). flags archive now requires --environment, since the path needs one; ARCHIVE removes the flag's definition from that environment
divergences.why: Rebuilt from the vendor docs (#29): Split takes the environment in the path, so a change request without it cannot be submitted.

divergences.old: operationType sent as UPDATE_SPLIT_DEFINITION, KILL_SPLIT, RESTORE_SPLIT and ARCHIVE_SPLIT (#79 item 3)
divergences.toil: UPDATE, KILL, RESTORE and ARCHIVE, the values Split lists for feature flags: https://docs.split.io/reference/create-change-request and https://developer.harness.io/docs/feature-management-experimentation/api/approvals

divergences.old: --approvers a,b sent as approvers: [{ id: "a" }, { id: "b" }], and approvers left out when not given (#79 item 4)
divergences.toil: approvers is an array of the email addresses given, trimmed, and [] when none are; the flag help says emails. The flag keeps its contract spelling, --approvers <ids>
divergences.why: Rebuilt from the vendor docs (#29): Split takes approvers as email strings, and an empty array where the environment picks them (https://docs.split.io/reference/create-change-request, https://developer.harness.io/docs/feature-management-experimentation/api/approvals).

divergences.old: set-rule --treatment and set-default writing a single bucket as { treatment, size: 100000 } (#79 item 5)
divergences.why: Rebuilt from the vendor docs (#29): Split's examples write a whole bucket as 100 (https://docs.split.io/reference/create-change-request, https://docs.split.io/reference/full-update-feature-flag-definition-in-environment).

divergences.old: The change request body as { title, comment, crNumber, operationType, split: { name, environment: { id }, definition }, workspace: { id } }, with set-rule and set-default spreading the whole GET response, read-only fields included, into definition (#79 item 6)
divergences.toil: { split: { name, treatments, defaultTreatment, baselineTreatment, trafficAllocation, rules, defaultRule }, operationType, title, comment, approvers, rolloutStatus? }, flat as Split documents it (https://docs.split.io/reference/create-change-request). set-rule and set-default copy only those definition fields from the GET; update sends the --input-file object under split with name set from --flag, and refuses a file that isn't a JSON object. Split has no change-number field, so --change-number is appended to the comment as "Change number: <CHG>". A new --rollout-status <id> sends rolloutStatus: { id }
divergences.why: Rebuilt from the vendor docs (#29): a nested definition, crNumber and workspace are not in the reference body, and the GET returns fields Split owns.

divergences.old: environments list reading .objects from the response, which fails on a bare array (#79 item 7)
divergences.toil: The response is read as the bare array Split returns (https://docs.split.io/reference/get-environments). Anything else is an HTTP error saying so

divergences.old: workspaces list returning the first page only, with count the length of that page (#79 item 8)
divergences.toil: Every page, 100 at a time, until totalCount (https://docs.split.io/reference/get-workspaces); count is the number of workspaces
divergences.why: Rebuilt from the vendor docs (#29): the endpoint is paged, and the help says it lists all workspaces.

divergences.old: change-requests list GETting /internal/api/v2/changeRequests/ws/{ws}?limit&offset[&environmentId][&status], with totalCount from the server (#79 item 9)
divergences.toil: GET /changeRequests?workspaceId&environmentId&status&limit&after (https://docs.split.io/reference/list-change-requests). Split pages this list by marker: --offset other than 0 is refused with INVALID_INPUT, a new --after <marker> reads the next page, the output adds nextMarker and previousMarker, meta.page.nextCursor is nextMarker, and totalCount is null because Split reports no total
divergences.why: Rebuilt from the vendor docs (#29): the documented path is the submit path, and the list takes markers, not offsets.

divergences.old: set-rule --weights with invalid JSON failing with the raw SyntaxError
divergences.toil: INVALID_INPUT naming --weights, with an example of the expected array
divergences.why: An error says plainly what went wrong and what to do; a raw SyntaxError would reach the envelope as an INTERNAL "bug in toil".

divergences.old: workspaces list paging (new, above) with no bound
divergences.toil: Paging stops after 1,000 pages with an HTTP error naming the list ("Paging Split workspaces didn't end after 1000 pages")
divergences.why: A server that ignores offset hands back the same page forever; the bound turns a hang into an error that says what happened.
